summary: ZenaTech, Inc. furnished a Form 6-K (the non-US equivalent of a US Form 8-K current report) reporting preliminary third-quarter 2026 total revenues of US$9.5 million to US$10.5 million. The Vancouver-based prepackaged-software issuer (Nasdaq: ZENA; FSE: 49Q; BMV: ZENA) stated the ranges reflect incomplete quarter-end closing procedures, that the figures are unaudited and unreviewed by its independent registered public accounting firm, and included standard forward-looking-statement and risk-factor cautionary language signed by CEO Shaun Passley. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or special-situation event is described.
